# Source clerk and assembler brief v01 — first used on scan018

This is a source-only support role. Root decides every ink locus. Read only the current page's supplied text packet, reader returns explicitly released by root, root's crop journal, and the source structure needed for this job. Do not open images, crop, OCR, compile, render, research, install, delegate, or perform optional mathematical or coordinate computations. An existing finite computation must be copied with its actual scope and source; do not rerun it. The independent readers' original files remain unchanged.

## Record preparation

Preserve each actual reader difference, doubt, inventory row, graphical component, literal path and report-silent TeX choice with its original identity and exact source pointer. A compact source crosswalk can reference stored original files; every source must resolve unambiguously. Keep the actual C doubt-table row identity, with compound parts separately recorded. Notation, abbreviation and slip tables retain their actual source scope. Existing manuscript source words, accents, cancellation states and graphical components remain literal.

Make every public decision's `readers` mapping contain A, B and C. A reader's absence from its difference list supplies no reading. Use that reader's actual complete TeX excerpt, scope and reference for any report-silent choice. Preserve raw reported mappings separately and state source absence only within an inspected complete source span. The public builder consumes `readers` directly.

Every root-selected S confirmation must contain `S_id` and `S_status`; the builder uses those fields to display its identity. An S confirmation whose overbar is already present in C and H has zero C/H counts. An S row's broad range supplies no unobserved local example.

Use exact builder fields: `notes` is a string; `abbreviations` entries have `form` and `expansion` (the latter remains a probable expansion in the output heading); each doubt has `location`, `reading`, `alternatives`, `confidence` and `reason`; every inventory entry has the requested CSV fields and `transcribed: yes` only for selected source content. Preserve original alternate field names as provenance when needed.

## Counting and uncertainty

Root supplies all final count and confidence choices. One physical glyph/state/graphic cluster receives its selected count once. Shared H ill-placeholders or whole drawing replacements use one explicit parent; local component rows remain visible with zero duplicate count. Keep report rows and physical count loci separate. An actual C doubt resolution counts once; retaining the existing primary qualification, adding a supported alternative to it, or retaining an explicit blank alternative alone has no C count. A new qualification of previously firm content counts once. H's same primary reading with a changed editorial uncertainty marker alone has no H count; a changed primary with H's reading as a retained alternative remains qualified. Preserve each actual C status, including mixed component outcomes.

Every emitted row uses an allowed collation kind and an explicit `marked_in_H` Boolean grounded in the relevant H source or shared placeholder parent. Context used to anchor an omitted mark belongs in provenance; the public C/H reading must describe that mark's actual presence or absence.

## Exact selected-source assembly

Follow root's selected complete graphical group, including its adjacent words, nodes, scope translations, origin, baseline and local qualification. Retain each physical stroke once. A separately selected replacement cannot duplicate an overlapping component or adjoining word. The first occurrence per page carries a recurring-symbol unsure wrapper; later occurrences retain the selected primary while their independently inspected local doubts stay in the record.

The selected draft and source map must agree byte for byte. Supply complete source blocks, literal replacements, exact final offsets and attachment pointers for decisions, inventory and doubts. Every selected literal path must be traceable. Do not claim metric or rendered validation of manual drawing approximations. Keep physical paragraph blanks outside math delimiters.

The final source review is one targeted pass over actual coverage, source identities, selected exact text/paths, public fields, physical count parents and attachments. Narrow repairs found by that pass receive bounded follow-up. Preserve the earlier audit hashes and the exact scope of each repair. Do not broaden testing once the required defect is closed.

## Root handoff

Leave `main_adjudicated` and each `main_approved` false in the draft. Give the exact frozen draft/map/record hashes, current audit hash, counts, original C outcome counts and any actual unresolved issue. All public A/B/C fields, S identities and abbreviation fields must already be complete. Root reads the final selected source and record, approves it, and runs the structural commit gate. The gate binds the selected bytes to the final page and rebuilds all cumulative outputs before the next page starts.

Current approval fields in the committed record describe the completed approval. Earlier pending flags remain only in raw draft/proposal history. No source clerk declares root approval or writes a final page commit.

\[
U_{J,i}=X\setminus\mathop{\unsure{\coprod|\bigsqcup}}\limits_{\alpha\in \deleted{\unsure{J}}K_0}\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+

&\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+=\Sigma_\alpha^+\cup E_\alpha.

\[
U=U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^-=X\setminus\left(\coprod_{\alpha\in K_0}\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+\ \cup\ \widehat{\Sigma}_i^+\right)

U_{J,i} = X\setminus\coprod_{\alpha\in K_0}\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+

\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+ = \Sigma_\alpha^+\cup E_\alpha .

U = U_{J,i}\cap\Sigma_i^- = X\setminus\Bigl(\coprod_{\alpha\in K_0}
\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+ \cup \widehat{\Sigma}_i^+\Bigr)
\]
\struck{Soit} \uncertain{Au} \uncertain{dernier} $=$, dans la

$\alpha\in K_0$ tels que $\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+\not\subset

\]

"""One planned enlargement per unresolved locus; no OCR or image comparisons."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageFilter
import json

base = Path(__file__).parent
source = Path('/workspace/scratch/94548b74fbe0/source/SP40_CW_81_scans/J81-03_81_scan019.jpg')
plans = [
    ('01_top_endpoint', [1400,65,1692,175], 'First-line 0,1 ending and punctuation at physical edge', []),
    ('02_avec', [250,255,800,355], 'Detached compressed word before card I >= 3', ['R09']),
    ('03_first_u', [550,505,1015,640], 'First U entrance and possible cancelled equality, plus index and signs', ['R10']),
    ('04_lune', [930,735,1555,850], 'l’une / l’un and terminal punctuation with full adjoining words', ['R11']),
    ('05_ona_recurrence', [720,850,1290,950], 'End of récurrence and very small on a', ['R02']),
    ('06_first_union', [490,935,1205,1135], 'First large union form and overwritten lower index', ['R03','R04']),
    ('07_brace_predecessor', [595,1160,980,1290], 'Sigma predecessor and lower index beneath K0', ['R12']),
    ('08_brace_e_index', [680,1360,1270,1480], 'Small final E index on third brace line', []),
    ('09_ona_donc', [250,1480,675,1595], 'Overwritten opening On and following a before donc', ['R05']),
    ('10_ordinal', [260,1765,1045,1875], 'Struck Soit, Au, ordinal and equality punctuation', []),
    ('11_struck_word', [1210,1755,1605,1880], 'Struck word after dans la with complete endpoints', ['R06']),
    ('12_borner_sommer', [345,1990,1120,2110], 'borner, à / colon and sommer', ['R07']),
    ('13_cet', [250,2195,1090,2290], 'soit K1 cet ens., donc', ['R08']),
    ('14_final_display', [595,2240,1520,2362], 'Final display and clipped union lower index at page foot', []),
]
im = Image.open(source)
manifest = []
for name, bbox, purpose, rows in plans:
    crop = ImageOps.autocontrast(im.crop(tuple(bbox)))
    width = 2800
    crop = crop.resize((width, round(crop.height * width / crop.width)), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    crop = crop.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=1.1, percent=120, threshold=3))
    rel = f'crops/{name}.png'
    crop.save(base / rel)
    manifest.append({'path': rel, 'bbox': bbox, 'rotation': 0, 'purpose': purpose,
                     'C_source_rows': rows, 'source': str(source),
                     'coordinates': 'original full-scan pixels, upper-left origin',
                     'output_size': list(crop.size), 'viewed': False})
(base / 'crops' / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'created': len(manifest), 'source_size': list(im.size), 'output_directory': str(base/'crops')}))

"""Required source-only structural/record audit; no rendering or image reads."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, re

base=Path(__file__).parent
tex=(base/'reading.tex').read_text()
report=json.loads((base/'report.json').read_text())
body='\n'.join(line.split('%',1)[0] for line in tex.splitlines())
depth=0
for pos,ch in enumerate(body):
    if ch in '{}':
        backslashes=0
        q=pos-1
        while q>=0 and body[q]=='\\':
            backslashes+=1
            q-=1
        if backslashes%2:
            continue
        depth+=1 if ch=='{' else -1
        assert depth>=0, ('unmatched closing brace',pos)
assert depth==0, ('brace depth',depth)
stack=[]
for m in re.finditer(r'\\(begin|end)\{([^}]+)\}',body):
    if m.group(1)=='begin':
        stack.append(m.group(2))
    else:
        assert stack and stack.pop()==m.group(2), ('environment mismatch',m.group(0))
assert not stack
assert body.count('\\[')==body.count('\\]')==5
assert body.count('\\(')==body.count('\\)')==1
for display in re.findall(r'\\\[([\s\S]*?)\\\]',body):
    assert not re.search(r'\n\s*\n',display)
assert r'\cotefile' not in body
assert body.count(r'\scanpage{19}')==1
assert '% archive sheet number: 18' in tex
assert len(re.findall(r'\\draw\[',body))==11
allowed={'scanpage','operatorname','unsure','geqslant','figure','mathord','begin','end','coordinate','path','draw','cap','Sigma','underset','phantom','text','cdot','setminus','mathop','limits','alpha','in','deleted','widehat','left','right','subset','qquad','forall','pi','cup','bigcup','not'}
commands=set(re.findall(r'\\([A-Za-z]+)',body))
assert commands<=allowed, commands-allowed
for fragment in [r'\unsure{avec}',r'les ens.',r'\unsure{on a}',r'\deleted{\unsure{J|j}}K_0',r'\deleted{\Sigma_{\unsure{\alpha|0}}}K_0',r'\unsure{On a|\deleted{On}On a}',r'\unsure{dernier|deuxième}',r'\deleted{\unsure{somme|réunion}}',r'\unsure{à|:} sommer',r'$K_1$ cet ens.',r"\text{\unsure{l'une|l'un}}"]:
    assert fragment in tex,fragment
assert len(report['source_C_doubt_rows'])==12
assert [r['id'] for r in report['source_C_doubt_rows']]==[f'R{i:02}' for i in range(1,13)]
assert sum(r['status']=='resolved' for r in report['source_C_doubt_rows'])==3
assert sum(r['status']=='retained' for r in report['source_C_doubt_rows'])==9
ids={d['id'] for d in report['differences']}
for row in report['source_C_doubt_rows']:
    assert set(row['local_decision_ids'])<=ids
for d in report['differences']:
    assert d['H'] is not None
    if d['readers_crop']:
        assert (base/d['readers_crop']).is_file()
for c in report['crops']:
    assert (base/c['path']).is_file() and c['successful_deliveries']==1 and c['viewed']
assert len(report['image_ledger'])==17
assert len({x['path'] for x in report['image_ledger']})==17
assert all(x['successful_deliveries']==1 for x in report['image_ledger'])
assert report['counts']['diff_C']==sum(d['diff_C'] for d in report['differences'])==9
assert report['counts']['diff_H']==sum(d['diff_H'] for d in report['differences'])==14
assert report['S_page_scope']['id']=='SA01-K81-06'
result={'source_only':True,'braces':'balanced','environments':'balanced','display_pairs':5,'inline_math_pairs':1,'literal_draw_paths':11,'allowed_commands':'pass','crop_references':'exist','source_C_rows':'12/12, 3 resolved, 9 retained','image_ledger':'17 distinct delivered images; each once','reading_report_selected_fragments':'pass','compilation_or_rendering':False,'image_reads_in_audit':0}
(base/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

notes.page_content: Continuation of a handwritten induction argument. It gives paired intersections, an indexed complement expression, three brace conditions, a second complement expression, restriction of indices to K1, and a final complement expression. The wording and formulas are transcribed as written, with qualified ink readings retained.
notes.title_date_page_counts: No title, date or manuscript page number observed. Archive numeral 18 at bottom left is recorded in a comment. H page18 corresponds to scan019.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: Followed the displayed indices, roofs, plus/minus signs, unions, set differences and crossed inclusions locally. No algebraic repair, theorem reconstruction, conditional theorem or proof check was performed.
notes.H_apparatus: The two H note macros are editorial explanations. They do not add manuscript words and create no collation rows. H editorial uncertain markers alone create no differences when the primary text is unchanged.
notes.S_row_scope: SA01-K81-06 spans several scans and explicitly reports no scan viewing. Its proposed examples were not silently transferred. Nine local Sigma roofs were inspected as roofs; current C/H already preserve them. No unobserved closure bar was supplied.
notes.image_processing: Full source dimensions 1692 by 2362; each half 1692 by 1261. Source crops use full-scan coordinates, x right/y down, without alignment or pixel-difference computation. PIL crop, autocontrast, Lanczos resize to width2800 and UnsharpMask(radius1.1,percent120,threshold3) were used. No rotations.
notes.image_ledger: Whole once, half a once, half b once, 15 preplanned crops once each; all delivered successfully. No reopenings, retries, OCR, research, compilation, rendering, installs or other-page reads.
notes.graphical_sources: G01 is a manual complete first-U approximation with three literal paths. G02 has two fills for two lower traces; G03 has two fills for the far-right point pair. Fixed source origins, units and baselines are given in reading.tex. Their source coordinates are not metric/render validation.
boundary_limits: Crop02 reaches the physical right edge at numeral1; unseen punctuation is not supplied.
Crop15 preserves the whole last display available on the sheet; the lower K1 end meets the physical bottom edge. Its top edge clips part of the previous prose line, which was already read in half b.
notes.other_surface_observations: Diffuse gray paper texture without a discrete supported character was not converted into text. G02/G03 retain discrete candidate paths while their surface origin remains unresolved.
notes.structural_verification: Final structural source checks passed: braces, environments, five display pairs, no physical blank line within a display, allowed collation kinds, 12 source-row mappings, 15 crop references and count consistency. The checker initially had a Python quote error and then treated comment-only lines as blank paragraphs; its own source was corrected. Neither checker issue required a transcription change. No TeX compiler or renderer was invoked.

notes.page_content: Continuation headed Dém. par récurrence. The text gives cardinality cases, the written U expressions and three braced conditions, then names K1 in the lower prose and ends with another complement-of-union expression. These statements are transcribed; no proof check is claimed.
notes.paragraph_order: Opening proof prose, paired display, following prose, recurrence lead-in and equality, où and brace, On a donc and display, lower paragraph and final display.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The mathematical expressions identified the local targets: large join glyphs, predecessor indices, hats, lower limits and noninclusion strokes. No expected identity, theorem, grammatical repair or mathematical correction was used to settle an unreadable mark.

S_row_handling.result: The three quoted examples in the supplied broad-range row do not occur verbatim on this page. The visible raised signs at this page’s nine hatted Sigma occurrences are angular roofs already represented in current C/H. No new closure bar is inferred.

notes.H_apparatus: H’s two note macros concerning neighboring sheets and its page label are apparatus. No prose is invented from them, and no H collation count is assigned merely for their omission.
notes.image_order: Whole once, a once, b once; then crop01 through crop16 once each. All deliveries succeeded. No image was reopened.
notes.image_processing: PIL crop, autocontrast, LANCZOS resize to width 2800 and UnsharpMask only. No OCR or recognition, no source pixel matching, no image difference calculation, no optional geometry calculation.
notes.coordinate_maps: Full scan 1692x2362; each half 1692x1261. a uses y_full=y_a; b uses y_full=y_b+1101, with 1101=2362-1261. Crop boxes all use the original full scan upper-left origin.
notes.graphical_representation: M01, M03 and M04 use fixed local rectangles and literal paths/fills with their full-scan origins written in the TeX comments. M02 and M05 use qualified dot candidates. These preserve observed shapes without assigning a character role, mathematical operation, hand or surface origin. Font extents and surrounding TeX placement are manual approximations, not rendered or metrically validated.
notes.crop_boundaries: Crop01 and crop15 include the physical right/bottom paper boundaries. Crop13 contains the entire target K1/cet/ens./donc group; its upper boundary cuts only the preceding line’s long descender. Crop16 contains the whole isolated pale trace but no adjacent text line. No repeat crop was made.
notes.validation: Only structural source checks are authorized: braces, delimiters, environments, macro names, file references and reading/report consistency. No compilation, rendering or installation is performed.
notes.source_validation_history: The first source-only pass treated comment-only lines as blank paragraphs. The validator was corrected to inspect actual physical blank lines in the unstripped source. The required repeated source-only pass returned no errors; the TeX source did not need a blank-line repair.

# Scan 019 — independent reader A

Start recorded before packet/image reading: **2026-11-20 19:48:18 UTC**.

Completed and frozen after required source verification: **2026-11-20 20:01:00 UTC**.

Read the complete assigned brief, C, H, metadata, C doubt table, empty C notes, C inventory, S row, notation snapshot and preamble. No other reader, page, root decision or prior-page record was inspected. No OCR, research, compilation, rendering, installation or manuscript mathematical proof check was performed.

## Once-only visual ledger

The whole scan was delivered first, then half a, then half b, each once. Fourteen planned tight enlargements followed in numerical order, each once. There were **17 successful image deliveries, no failed unseen deliveries and no reopens**. `image_ledger.json` gives every path and delivery ordinal. `crops/manifest.json` gives every full-scan box, transformation and purpose. Image dimensions were read as 1692 × 2362 for the whole and 1692 × 1261 for both halves; half b has full-scan y-offset 1101. No image-alignment calculation was performed.

## Line-by-line reading audit

| Physical position | Selected reading and visible evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Top line | `Dém. par récurrence, c'est trivial si card I = 0,1`. Abbreviation point, accents, comma after récurrence, apostrophe, equality and comma between 0 and 1 retained. Crop01 reaches the physical right edge: 1 is readable, further endpoint punctuation cannot be recovered. |
| Line 2 | `Le cas card I = 2 a été vu. Cas général`. Tall initial L is read as capital. Points and local accents retained. |
| Line 3 | Doubtful `avec`, then `card I ≥ 3, on choisit J comme`. Crop02 leaves the three compressed groups of avec unresolved. The lower inequality stroke is sloping; `geqslant` represents that shape without a separate inequality-reading count. |
| Line 4 | `dessus. Il suffit de voir que les`. All wording and the point after dessus visible. |
| Line 5 | `ens.` is readable from half a, including its terminal point; original C row R01 resolved. |
| Paired display | `U_{J,i} cap Sigma_i^+, U_{J,i} cap Sigma_i^-`. Each J/i index, intersection and raised sign inspected. Crop03 leaves the first U entrance/cancelled-equality question open. G01 preserves the body and two entrance runs once under a local qualifier. |
| First line below paired display | `ont la forme précédente, il suffit`. Accents and comma retained. |
| Next line | `de le voir pour l'une / l'un des deux.` Crop04 preserves both word candidates, l’une first. One dark point below the word’s terminal run is preserved separately and locally qualified; its attachment and hand remain open. The terminal point after deux is clear. |
| Next lead-in | `Par hyp. de récurrence, on a`. Crop05 leaves the very small on a unresolved; the comma after récurrence is visible and already present in both witnesses. |
| First equality | `U_{J,i} = X setminus [footed union] hat Sigma_alpha^+`. Crop06 shows the rounded bowl, extending foot and two retraced/supporting runs, reproduced in G03. Coprod/bigsqcup remain the original glyph-name alternatives. The fine predecessor under the lower K0 remains J/j uncertain; current K0 is clear. |
| Left of brace | `où`, with its accent retained. |
| Brace line 1 | A Sigma predecessor under K0, then `K0 subset J`. Crop07 recovers Sigma; its lower alpha/zero loop remains unresolved. The live K0 and inclusion are clear. |
| Brace line 2 | `Sigma_alpha^+ in pi0(X setminus E_alpha) (forall alpha in K0)`. Each index, parenthesis, membership and quantifier retained from half b. |
| Brace line 3 | `hat Sigma_alpha^+ = Sigma_alpha^+ cup E_alpha.` Crop08 settles the terminal E index as alpha from its small loop and outgoing stroke. The point is clear. No witness change at this formula. |
| Lead-in below brace | `On a donc`, with complete-state alternative cancelled `On` plus `On a`. Crop09 shows an overlapped initial capital and one low continuation. The possible cancellation remains explicit; H’s state survives as an alternative. |
| Lower display | `U = U_{J,i} cap Sigma_i^- = X setminus ([footed union] hat Sigma_alpha^+ cup hat Sigma_i^+)`. All signs, indices, roofs and parentheses inspected on half b. G04 reproduces the second local bowl/foot/retrace group; coprod/bigsqcup remains locally qualified in the report, with the printed first qualifier at G03. |
| Lower paragraph opening | Struck `Soit`, then `Au dernier / deuxième =, dans la` and a struck word. Crop10 gives dernier as my primary; compressed strokes leave deuxième possible. Equality and comma retained. |
| Struck word | Crop11 retains `somme / réunion`, with somme primary and low confidence; one long strike crosses the middle. One H ill placeholder is replaced by these qualified candidates. |
| Next line | Live `réunion`, indexed curved union of roofed Sigma, comma, `il suffit de`. Live wording and roof inspected in half b. |
| Next line | `se borner à / : sommer sur les`, then struck Sigma. Crop12 leaves the tiny à/colon sign open, à primary. Sommer is readable through its separate low letter groups and final hook; original C row R07 resolved. The struck Sigma is preserved. |
| Next line | `alpha in K0 tels que hat Sigma_alpha^+ notsubset hat Sigma_i^+ i.e. Sigma_alpha^+ notsubset Sigma_i^+`. Each roof, index, plus, crossed inclusion and abbreviation point read from half b. |
| Last prose line | `soit K1 cet ens., donc`. Crop13 settles cet, including final tall t; original C row R08 resolved. The point after ens and separate following comma are retained. The long downstroke entering this crop belongs to the preceding que and is not duplicated. |
| Final display | `U = X setminus (union_{alpha in K1} hat Sigma_alpha^+ cup hat Sigma_i^+)`. Crop14 shows the indexed group at the page foot. The lower end of K1 touches the physical edge; its surviving form supports K1. Both roofs, plus signs and final parenthesis are retained. No extra endpoint punctuation supplied. |
| Lower-left archive mark | Pale `18`, recorded only as the archive-number comment. Attribution remains undetermined. |

The following identifiers preserve the twelve supplied rows’ exact order. The preceding notation table is not an additional doubt list.

The report has **18 local records**: **9 marked diff_C** and **14 marked diff_H**. The counts include literal graphical additions and C doubt resolutions, and exclude same-reading macro conversions and metadata handling. The edge-limited comma comparison A18 is explicitly provisional; H’s possible comma cannot be decisively rejected beyond the surviving sheet boundary.

Principal selected differences are the primary `dernier` with `deuxième` retained, the newly explicit à/colon doubt, the resolved ens./sommer/cet readings, recovery of the overwritten indices and struck-word candidates omitted by H, and the literal U/union details. H’s `l'un` and cancelled-On state remain supported alternatives. No uncertainty-only removal from an unchanged H reading is counted.

G01, G03 and G04 contain **11 literal draw paths** in total. Their exact local origin, rectangle, baseline, scale and component inventory are recorded in `reading.tex` and `report.json`; these are manual approximations. G02 uses one standard positioned dot, without a supplied semantic role. The complete selected words and formulas occur once. No render or metric claim is made.

## S row and notation scope

S `SA01-K81-06` covers a broad scan range and records that its author viewed no scan. Its quoted examples do not occur verbatim on scan019. I inspected the roofed and plain Sigma occurrences on this sheet. The roofs already appear in current C and H as `widehat`; **no S-driven closure-bar correction is proposed**. Crop03 and crop06 expose the plain/roofed Sigma head constructions locally. No mathematical correspondence or proof check was used to choose or repair them.

H’s page label and two explanatory notes are editorial apparatus. The repeated C `cotefile{81}` is omitted under the supplied current convention; `scanpage{19}` and archive comment `18` remain. These source-format choices carry no additional physical ink count.

## Validation scope

Final verification is source-only: balanced braces and environments, allowed macros, literal single-backslash TeX, complete source-row identities, existing crop references, honest image counts and reading/report agreement.
